summary: Eldest daughter of Revolutionary patriot Ensign Thomas Lamoreaux, who married Samuel Pringle in 1790; John's 5th-great-grandmother and the link in his patriot line.
bio:
Martha Lamoreaux was the eldest daughter of Ensign Thomas Lamoreaux, a Revolutionary patriot, and his wife Keturah Tuttle, and was born in Orange County, New York, about 1770 to 1772. In 1790 she married Samuel Pringle, and her father's will later names her as Martha Pringle. She died at Plymouth in Luzerne County, Pennsylvania. Some accounts give her a birth in October 1776 and a death on 27 August 1859, but those dates appear to have been copied from her sister Elizabeth, and her true death date is uncertain.

Martha is John's 5th-great-grandmother and the link that carries his descent from a Revolutionary patriot. The Sons of the American Revolution list her among Thomas Lamoreaux's children, but the approved applications on his record all run through his sons James and Thomas, so an application by John would open a new line through Martha.

researchNotes: Martha was the eldest daughter (born BET 1770 AND 1772) of Thomas and Keturah (Tuttle) Lamoreaux and married Samuel Pringle in 1790 (Harvey Book pp.134-135). She was therefore born about 1770-72. The tree's birth of 1776 ('1776-Deceased') and WikiTree's 18 Oct 1776, only 18 days after her sister Elizabeth's 30 Sep 1776, plus WikiTree's death date of 27 Aug 1859 (also Elizabeth's), look copied from Elizabeth; her real death date is unverified. Her father's will names 'Martha Pringle'. The SAR's record for Thomas lists Martha among his children, but all three approved applications (1995, 2014, 2017) go through his sons James or Thomas; John's application would open a new line through Martha.
